public_rationale: The capability component holds. Artificial Analysis placed Gemini 3 Pro above GPT-5.1 on its broad intelligence index before publication. Adoption evidence shows erosion, but not disappearance, of OpenAI's substantial lead: Similarweb's December 2 release put ChatGPT at 71.3% of tracked website traffic and Gemini at 15.1%. Thus the evidence supports lost technical leadership and a narrowing adoption advantage, while contradicting the breadth of 'by any reasonable measure.' A capability-only reading would support the claim more fully, so interpretation materially affects the result.
limitations: Benchmarks measure selected tasks and do not establish superiority on every real-world use.
The traffic figures cover website visits, not the whole AI market.
Calcalist and Similarweb report the same traffic dataset and are not independent corroborating measurements.
The historical baseline demonstrates earlier leadership without proving a uniform advantage over every rival.
No causal finding about managerial waste is proposed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has squandered the sizable lead it once had in AI.

statement.excerpt: By any reasonable measure OpenAI has clearly squandered the sizable lead they once had.

from_speaker: the sizable lead they once had
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that competitors had erased OpenAI's substantial competitive advantage by publication. The surrounding discussion makes model capability central, while the reference to users also makes adoption relevant.

Assess model capability and consumer adoption separately. Losing first place on broad model evaluations supports the capability component; retaining a substantial adoption advantage contradicts the unrestricted wording.
Use November 1 through December 3, 2025 as the current observation window: the latest completed month and the days through publication. Earlier evidence establishes the historical baseline only.
Read 'squandered' as loss of an advantage. Whether management culpably caused that loss is a separate causal judgment that these comparisons cannot establish.
A shrinking lead is not necessarily an erased lead. No numerical threshold or weighting between capability and adoption is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous comparisons show rivals matching or surpassing OpenAI across broad model evaluations, with adoption evidence also showing that its substantial lead had disappeared. Evidence confined to capability supports only that component.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence shows OpenAI retaining a substantial advantage on a central, ordinary measure of leadership, such as consumer adoption. A broad capability lead would contradict the capability component; a substantial adoption lead would contradict the claim's unrestricted breadth.

evidence.locator: Overview, Gaps between proprietary and open-source models; Table 1
evidence.explanation: The historical table places GPT-4 first at 1274 and Claude-v1 second at 1224. This establishes an earlier lead, although the report also describes Claude as competitive in their limited direct comparisons.

evidence.locator: Opening paragraph following the Gemini 3 Pro introduction
evidence.explanation: The model is Gemini 3 Pro Preview. The dated report places it three index points above GPT-5.1 and first on five of ten component evaluations, supporting the loss of OpenAI's broad capability lead.

evidence.locator: Key Takeaways; 12 Months Ago and Today traffic-share tables
evidence.explanation: The tables show ChatGPT's website traffic share falling from 87.0% a year earlier to 71.3%, while Gemini rose from 5.7% to 15.1%. This supports erosion of OpenAI's adoption advantage, but the same figures show that a substantial lead remained.

evidence.locator: Third article paragraph, reporting Similarweb's December 2 release
evidence.explanation: The Hebrew sentence reports ChatGPT's decline from 87% to 71.3%; the following sentence gives Gemini 15.1%. These are the website-traffic figures verified in Similarweb's primary release, showing a continuing substantial lead and contradicting the claim's unrestricted breadth.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A specified meaning of 'lead' would determine whether capability alone settles the claim or whether adoption must also count. Comparable historical app, API, and enterprise usage data would strengthen the broader assessment.
